title: A Protocol for Studying HIV-1 Envelope Glycoprotein Function
protocol: Maintain 293T cells in DMEM medium.
Monitor cell growth rate and morphology daily.
Wash 293T cells once with PBS.
Add 1–2 mL of StemPro Accutase to detach the cells while preserving receptor expression.
Incubate at RT (20°C–25°C) until cells are completely detached.
Add 10 mL of DMEM to the flask and collect the detached cells.
Mix the cell suspension slowly by pipetting up and down.
Filter the cell suspension if aggregation occurs using a polystyrene round-bottom tube with cell-strainer cap.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Add 5 × 10^5 cells/well to a 6-well plate or 3 × 10^6 cells/T-25 flask.
Incubate the plate/flask overnight (14–20 h) at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Replace medium with fresh DMEM medium for transfection.
Follow manufacturer’s instructions to prepare the transfection mixture.
Add dropwise the transfection mixture to cells with gentle swirling.
Gently swirl the plate/flask to ensure uniform distribution of the transfection complex.
Incubate plate/flask in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Prepare 293T cells for transfection as described for day 0.
Incubate the plate/flask for 4–5 hours in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration to allow cell attachment.
Add chloroquine to a final concentration of 25 μM, incubate for 5 minutes.
Prepare the Ca3(PO4)2 transfection mixture.
Add the transfection mixture dropwise to the cells with gentle swirling.
Transfer the plate/flask to the BSL2+ facility according to institutional biosafety protocol.
Follow BSL3 practices in a BSL-2 environment at the BSL2+ facility.
Wear disposable gown, face mask, protective shatterproof eyeglasses or face shield, double gloves, sleeve cover, and protective shoe covers as standard personal protective equipment.
Decontaminate liquid waste with 10% bleach.
Autoclave all waste on site.
Replace medium with fresh DMEM medium 14 hours post Ca3(PO4)2 transfection.
Change the medium again 14–16 hours post transfection to avoid chloroquine toxicity.
Gently collect PV-containing supernatant and centrifuge at 600–900 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C to remove cell debris.
Collect the supernatant and aliquot in required volume for single-use experiments in several 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Reserve one tube for p24 measurement.
Filter PV-containing supernatant through a 0.45 μm filter as an alternative method.
Compare centrifugation and filtration methods for specific Envs to achieve high infectivity.
Use a centrifugation step followed by 0.45 μm filtration of the PV-containing supernatant in some studies.
Store PV-containing tubes at -80°C for future use.
Collect supernatant with minimal mixing or mechanical force to preserve virus infectivity.
Lysate remaining cells in the wells/flask with luciferase lysis buffer after collecting supernatant.
Transfer a few microliters of lysed cells (usually 1:10 or 1:100 of the lysate) to a 96-well white luminometer plate.
Measure luciferase activity in the transferred sample.
Add equal volume of PV sample to a tube containing lysis buffer (1% Triton X-100 in PBS).
Store the lysed sample at -20°C until use.
Immobilize a capture antibody on high-binding 96-well plates by adding 4 μg/mL antibody solution to each well.
Seal the plate and incubate overnight at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the solution from each well using a vacuum system.
Wash each well three times with wash buffer, incubating for 30 seconds between washes.
Invert the plate on a paper towel to remove remaining traces of wash buffer.
Add blocking buffer to each well and incubate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 1-2 hours.
Repeat the Wash Step as previously described.
Prepare p24 protein standards at specified concentrations in duplicates using serial 1:2 dilutions.
Add 100 μL of p24 protein standards to respective wells.
Dilute test samples and add 100 μL of each sample to respective wells.
Incubate the plate at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 2 hours.
Repeat the Wash Step as previously described.
Add 100 μL/well of detection antibody at a final concentration of 125 ng/mL.
Incubate the plate at RT (20°C–25°C) for 1 hour.
Repeat the wash step.
Add 100 μL/well of streptavidin-HRP solution at a 1:40 dilution.
Incubate the plate at RT (20°C–25°C) for 20–30 minutes.
Repeat the wash step.
Add 100 μL/well of TMB substrate solution.
Incubate at RT (20°C–25°C) for 15–20 minutes.
Add 50 μL/well stop solution.
Shake to improve distribution of color development in the well.
Measure optical density in each well at wavelength of 450 nm within 5–30 minutes.
Analyze the data, averaging and subtracting the blank readout from each measurement.
Plot averaged and blank-subtracted p24 measurements against each concentration to generate a standard curve.
Calculate p24 concentration in tested samples using the equation describing the fitted linear curve.
Prepare serial 2-fold dilutions of supernatant-containing PVs in DMEM on Day 1.
Handle PVs gently and minimally during mixing to maintain even distribution without decreasing viral infectivity.
Add 30 μL of diluted PVs to each well in duplicates or triplicates on a 96-well plate.
Incubate T75 flask containing Cf2Th-CD4/CCR5 target cells with approximately 0.5 mL of StemPro Accutase at room temperature until cells are completely detached.
Centrifuge the detached cells at 50–100 × g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove supernatant from the centrifuged cells.
Resuspend the target cells in DMEM to achieve a concentration of 1.2 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add 60 μL of resuspended cells (7200 cells/well) to wells containing PVs.
Include control wells with no PVs and PVs without cells, both maintaining a total volume of 90 μL per well.
Incubate the plate in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Add target cells to a 96-well plate at a density of 7200 cells per well one day prior to the viral assay.
Add viruses on the next day following the addition of target cells.
Avoid adding target cells immediately after PV addition to prevent significantly higher assay readout.
Infect Cf2Th-CD4/CCR5 target cells with PVs for a higher assay readout compared to TZM-bl cells.
Use TZM-bl cells containing a stably integrated copy of the firefly luciferase gene under HIV long terminal repeat promoter in their genome.

Note that TZM-bl cells exhibit relatively high background and are contaminated with ecotropic murine leukemia virus, but this contamination does not significantly affect their performance as target cells.
Add DEAE-Dextran to increase the efficiency of viral entry into target cells.
Measure PV entry into target cells after 48 or 72 hours post infection.
Perform measurements 72 hours post-infection for higher readout due to accumulation of firefly luciferase enzyme in target cells.
Typically, a 48-hour incubation results in high signal-to-noise ratio and is preferred for time-saving purposes.
Prepare sufficient luciferase assay buffer for measurement in assay wells.
Thaw luciferin substrate solution at room temperature (20°C to 25°C).
Aspirate medium from the wells of a 96-well assay plate using a vacuum system.
Add 30 μL/well of luciferase lysis buffer to lyse cells and measure luciferase activity.
Prime injectors with assay buffer and luciferin substrate solution.
Inject 100 μL of assay buffer into each well.
Wait for a 1-second delay after injecting the assay buffer.
Inject 50 μL of luciferin substrate solution into each well.
Measure and integrate light units over 2 to 10 seconds.
Keep luciferin solution protected from light at all times.
Prepare serial dilutions of the tested ligand in DMEM.
Calculate the amount and volume needed for duplicate or triplicate measurements.
Dilute the ligand in microcentrifuge tubes according to calculations.
For small molecules dissolved in DMSO, initially dilute compounds in DMSO.
Further dilute DMSO-containing solutions in DMEM to achieve final concentrations.
Maintain identical DMSO concentration across all wells for consistency.
Include a reference infection well containing up to 2% DMSO without cytotoxic effects.
Add 30 μL of ligand at specific concentration to wells of a 96-well luminometer plate (Greiner bio-one 96-well plate).
Use 30 μL of the diluting medium for reference control (no ligands) and background (cells only) wells.
Add 30 μL PVs that were prediluted either to a defined amount of HIV-1 p24 or to specific infection level to assay and reference control wells.
Repeat step 13 of Virus titration section but resuspend the target cells in DMEM at concentration of 2.4 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add 30 μL/well of cells to the wells containing PVs, which were preincubated with a ligand, and to reference and background control wells.
Incubate the plate in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Prepare approximately 10 mL of PV displaying specific HIV-1 Envs according to the steps outlined in the first section.
Aliquot the supernatant-containing PVs into 20 or more microcentrifuge tubes and store at -80°C.
Measure HIV-1 p24 in the supernatant and titer the PVs as described in the previous section.
Thaw a single-use aliquot of PV preparation by immersing the tube in a 37°C water bath for exactly 1.5 min.
Gently place the tube in an ice bucket after thawing.
Place the ice bucket in a refrigerator to conserve the ice during incubation.
Label the tube as day 1.
Repeat step 23 daily for 3 consecutive days (days 2–4) at the same interval (approximately every 24 h).
On day 5, repeat step 23 but without placing the tube on ice.
PVs from day 5 tube are the reference for measuring 100% infectivity.
Dilute each PV preparation to 4 ng p24/60 μL or to a predefined infectivity level in DMEM.
Add 60 μL of each diluted PV to wells of a 96-well plate in triplicates or quadruplicates.
Add 60 μL of 1.2 × 105 Cf2Th-CD4/CCR5 target cells/mL (7200 cells/well) to the wells containing diluted PV.
Incubate the plate in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Transfect 293T cells with HIV-1 tat- and HIV-1 Env-expression plasmids at a ratio of 1:6 in a 6-well plate using Ca3(PO4)2 transfection method.
Incubate transfected cells in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Detach TZM-bl cells.
Centrifuge the detached cells at 50–100 × g and 4°C for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in DMEM, count them, and adjust to a concentration of 1 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Add 100 μL of resuspended cells to designated wells of a 96-well plate.
Incubate the plate overnight (16–20 hours) at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Detach transfected 293T cells using 5 mM EDTA in PBS.
Transfer detached 293T cells to a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Add 10 mL of DMEM and centrifuge the cells at 50–100 × g and 10°C for 5 minutes.
Resuspend transfected 293T cells in fresh medium at a concentration of 2 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Remove 50 μL from assay wells containing TZM-bl target cells.
Add 50 μL of resuspended transfected 293T cells (10,000 cells/well) to the removed well space.
Incubate the plates in a tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 concentration.
Measure the fusion activity after 2 hours by following step 15 (a & b) of the Virus titration section.
Measure the fusion activity after 4 hours by following step 15 (a & b) of the Virus titration section.
Measure the fusion activity after 6 hours by following step 15 (a & b) of the Virus titration section.
